Here is a transcription of the historical marriage register from `image_e17265.png`.

The document is written in Latin, which was standard for Catholic parish registers of this era (1853–1854). Abbreviations have been expanded or transcribed as written where clear, and the repeating officiating priest's signature has been noted as "**Lawr. Harnett**" (Lawrence Harnett).
